canonical_project: Crnogorski Telekom Bijelo Polje Disaster Recovery Data Center
notes: Vijesti reported Crnogorski Telekom opened the Bijelo Polje Data Center on 2011-04-29 and said Deutsche Telekom standards were applied. DataCenterMap/Data Center Catalog list a Bijelo Polje facility described as a disaster recovery data center for Podgorica; capacity was not publicly found.
